compliance_notes: Guest names, contact details, passport data and payment info are personal data.
Allergen and dietary information must be accurate; never rely on AI alone for allergen statements.
Replies to public reviews are public content; a person should approve sensitive ones.
follow_up_questions: How many booking enquiries and reviews do you get per month?
Which booking channels and systems do you use?
Do enquiries come in several languages?
Is there a person available to approve replies before they are sent?
